short_description:
Where to find the black bear, one of GTA 6's unique ("Snapmatic") animals: the southern edge of Hamlet, in the swamp country of southern Leonida. It only spawns after Bret Vogel texts you its clue (his hunting questline starts after you meet him in Chapter 2). Guides list its payout at $6,800 to $12,000. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #26 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: Insider Gaming, Mobalytics, Pro-Gamer, Keylento wiki.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).

El oso negro de GTA 6 vive en el borde sur de Hamlet. Solo aparece después de la pista de Bret (desde el capítulo 2). Las guías dicen que paga entre 6.800 y 12.000 dólares. Fuentes: Insider Gaming, Mobalytics.
